### Useful to the Lord
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-september-7-2026.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:31
Points:
- God can use any believer in meaningful ways that exceed human expectations.
- Believers should submit their ambitions and daily decisions to God's direction.
- Bringing glory to God must be the supreme priority across all areas of life.
- Any legitimate vocation or routine task can serve as an active witness for Jesus.
- Faithfulness in ordinary responsibilities allows God to fulfill His greater purposes through us.

### Beware of Heights!
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-mar-29-2010-11628123.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:31
Points:
- Achieving major life goals often lowers spiritual defenses and increases vulnerability to temptation.
- True spiritual integrity flourishes when the glory of God remains our central obsession.
- Resting on past victories frequently opens the door to moral compromise and spiritual decline.
- Believers must stay vigilant and continue walking carefully before God even after experiencing success.
